messages.subject: rstan on cran?
parts:

I saw the StanHeaders package to be listed on CRAN. This is a great step, but what about rstan? Will rstan 2.6.0 hit cran any time soon? I know that cran appears to be restrictive for package maintainers, but seeing StanHeaders makes be hope to see rstan on cran soon.

Many thanks!

Best,
Sebastian
